skill.name: appie-linkedin-growth
skill.description: Track LinkedIn profiles and list leads via Appie.run. Use when the user asks to track or stop tracking a LinkedIn profile, see which profiles are tracked, or list LinkedIn leads with their email or phone. Triggers include track this LinkedIn profile, LinkedIn leads, show my tracked profiles, stop tracking, lead emails, LinkedIn growth.
skill.summary: Manage tracked LinkedIn profiles and retrieve existing leads through the Appie.run MCP integration.
skill.author: appierun

security_audit.summary: All 18 static findings are false positives: Markdown backticks are not executable commands, and the URLs document the intended Appie integration. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or unrelated data transfers in SKILL.md. One semantic concern remains: tracking defaults to enabled, but the workflow discloses scheduled scan costs only after saving.

remediation.issue: Tracking can enable scheduled credit spending before the workflow discloses the cost.
remediation.suggestion: Before enabling tracking, disclose the existing scan schedule and 30-credit scan cost, then obtain user confirmation before calling set_linkedin_profile.

static_findings.snippet: 1. Check whether the Appie tools (e.g. `get_linkedin_profiles`, `list_linkedin_leads`) are already a
- Header: `Authorization: Bearer <esk_...>` (your Appie.run project API key, starting with `esk_`)
| List profiles       | `get_linkedin_profiles`   | free | profiles this project tracks |
| Add/update profile  | `set_linkedin_profile`    | free to save | scheduled scans cost 30 |
| List leads          | `list_linkedin_leads`     | free to list | lookups cost 5 per lead |
- `tracking_enabled` (optional, default true) — set false to stop tracking
- `tracked_profile_id` (optional) — only leads for one tracked profile
- Leads include `email` and `phone` when a lookup has found them.
2. Call set_linkedin_profile with `profile_url` (and `tracking_enabled: false` to pause).
2. Present the leads in a compact table. Show `email` and `phone` only when the result includes them
- `insufficient_credits` → report the costs (30 per scan, 5 per lookup) and stop. Do not retry.
- `app_not_allowed` → the key's owner can't use the LinkedIn app; ask a project owner or admin.
- Setup docs for each client: https://appie.run/docs/mcp

content.user_title: Manage LinkedIn Tracking and Leads with Appie
content.value_statement: Tracking LinkedIn profiles and reviewing collected leads requires clear project visibility. This skill guides Appie MCP tools to manage tracking and display available contact details.
actual_capabilities: List LinkedIn profiles tracked by the current Appie project.
Add or update a LinkedIn profile using a user-provided profile URL.
Pause profile tracking by setting tracking_enabled to false.
Retrieve existing leads with an optional profile filter and a maximum limit of 50.
Display returned email and phone fields without guessing missing contact details.
Explain credit costs and stop when the service reports insufficient credits.
limitations: Requires a connected Appie.run MCP server and a project API key with LinkedIn app access.
Does not provide tools to trigger immediate scans, change schedules, or perform contact lookups.
Scheduled scans cost 30 credits each, and contact lookups cost 5 credits per lead.
Lead availability depends on scheduled scans, and email or phone details may be missing.

use_cases.title: Review Prospect Leads
use_cases.description: List leads for a selected tracked profile and review contact details returned by Appie.

use_cases.title: Manage Founder Profile Tracking
use_cases.description: Add a relevant LinkedIn profile after reviewing scan costs, or pause tracking when it is no longer needed.

use_cases.title: Audit Project Tracking
use_cases.description: Review tracked profiles with their identifiers and resolve ambiguous profile filters before retrieving leads.

prompt_templates.title: List Tracked Profiles
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the LinkedIn profiles tracked by my current Appie project. Include their returned identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Pause Profile Tracking
prompt_templates.prompt: Stop tracking this LinkedIn profile: [profile URL]. Confirm the result returned by Appie.

prompt_templates.title: Review Filtered Leads
prompt_templates.prompt: List up to 20 leads for tracked profile [profile ID]. Show available email and phone details, leaving missing values blank.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: retrieve a focused lead list.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Enabling Tracking
prompt_templates.prompt: Review tracked profiles, then prepare to track [profile URL]. Explain scheduled scan costs and ask for confirmation before enabling tracking.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine project review with explicit spending approval.

output_examples.input: Show my tracked profiles when Appie returns an empty list.
output_examples.output: No LinkedIn profiles are tracked in this project. Would you like to add one?

output_examples.input: List leads when Appie reports insufficient credits.
output_examples.output: Appie reported insufficient credits. Profile scans cost 30 credits each, and contact lookups cost 5 credits per lead. Processing has stopped.

output_examples.input: List leads when Appie returns no results for the selected profile.
output_examples.output: No leads were returned for this profile. Scans run on the existing schedule, so leads may appear later.

best_practices: Configure the project API key in your MCP client, never in chat.
Review scheduled scan costs and confirm spending before enabling profile tracking.
Keep returned profile identifiers and use them to filter leads precisely.
anti_patterns: Guessing email addresses or phone numbers when Appie does not return them.
Expecting immediate scans or new contact lookups from the listed tools.
Repeatedly retrying after insufficient credits or attempting to bypass project access restrictions.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect the Appie.run MCP server with a project API key. The key owner must have access to the LinkedIn app.

faq.question: Which operations are free?
faq.answer: Listing tracked profiles, saving a profile, and listing existing leads are free. Scheduled scans and contact lookups consume credits.

faq.question: How much do scans and lookups cost?
faq.answer: The skill documents 30 credits per scheduled scan and 5 credits per lead contact lookup.

faq.question: Can this skill start a scan immediately?
faq.answer: No. The documented tools manage profiles and list leads. Scans run on the existing schedule.

faq.question: Why are some email addresses or phone numbers missing?
faq.answer: Contact fields appear only when a lookup has found them. Missing values remain blank.

faq.question: Can I pause tracking or filter leads?
faq.answer: Yes. Disable tracking for a profile, or filter leads by tracked profile identifier. Lead requests support a maximum limit of 50.
